title: bug(MCP): parseMcpToolName fails when server name contains underscores

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue provides a detailed and actionable report of a bug in parseMcpToolName where MCP server names containing underscores fail to parse correctly. It includes affected code, reproduction steps, expected vs actual behavior, and context.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: The fix is localized to a single function (parseMcpToolName) in packages/core/src/tools/mcp-tool.ts and requires adding unit tests in packages/core/src/tools/mcp-tool.test.ts.

summary.problem: parseMcpToolName fails when MCP server names contain underscores, causing incorrect tool name resolution.
summary.root_cause: The regex /^([^_]+)_(.+)$/ in parseMcpToolName stops matching serverName at the first underscore after the mcp_ prefix, splitting names like mcp_my_server_my_tool into serverName 'my' and toolName 'server_my_tool'.
summary.context: MCP tool fully qualified names follow the format mcp_{serverName}_{toolName}. Server names frequently contain underscores (e.g. google_workspace, my_server), so parseMcpToolName must support underscores in server names.

steps: Update parseMcpToolName in packages/core/src/tools/mcp-tool.ts to parse tool names by splitting on the last underscore (/^(.+)_(.+)$/) or another strategy that permits underscores in server names.
Ensure parseMcpToolName correctly handles server names with underscores for both specific tool names and wildcard patterns (e.g. mcp_my_server_*).

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: parseMcpToolName accurately extracts serverName and toolName even when the server name contains underscores.
verification_steps: Add unit tests for parseMcpToolName in packages/core/src/tools/mcp-tool.test.ts.
Verify parsing for simple names like mcp_server_tool.
Verify parsing for server names with underscores like mcp_my_server_my_tool.
Verify parsing for wildcard tool names like mcp_my_server_*.
Verify invalid or non-MCP inputs return empty objects.
Run vitest on packages/core/src/tools/mcp-tool.test.ts to confirm all tests pass.
